newsitem.title: USA: Rocky Mountain Internet expects Q3 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Rocky Mountain Internet expects Q3 net loss.

text.p: Rocky Mountain Internet Inc said Tuesday it expects to post a net loss for the third quarter of about $575,000, or $0.13 per share.
It did not disclose its earnings for its third quarter in 1995. The company, which completed its initial public offering in early September, attributed the loss to its rapid growth.
Rocky Mountain said preliminary results showed revenue increased to about $905,000 in the quarter from $318,000 in the same period in the previous year.

It also said it has executed a letter of intent to acquire a Colorado Springs-based company it did not name. It described it as a competing provider of Internet and World Wide Web services. Terms were not disclosed.
Rocky Mountain is a regional Internet access provider.
